table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Type,
	AccountName, 
	GroupAccount,
	Debit= CASE WHEN Balance > 0 THEN Balance ELSE 0 END,
	Credit= CASE WHEN Balance < 0 THEN ABS(Balance) ELSE 0 END,
	AliasName
FROM
	(SELECT 
		Type=1,
		AccountName=A.Name, 
		GroupAccount=S.Name, 
		Balance=Sum(V.Debit - V.Credit), 
		AliasName=A.AliasName
	FROM VirtualGL V,
		  Accounts A,
		  SubAccounts S
	WHERE 
		A.AccCode NOT IN (SELECT AccCode FROM SummaryAccountDetail) AND
		A.AccCode = V.AccCode AND 
		A.SubCode = S.SubAccCode AND
		(A.Restricted = CASE WHEN :ar_restricted = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END OR
			A.Restricted = CASE WHEN :ar_restricted = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'N' END) AND
		V.Date <= :ar_Date
	GROUP BY A.AccCode, A.Name, S.Name, A.AliasName
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		Type=0,
		AccountName=SA.Name, 
		GroupAccount=NULL, 
		Balance=Sum(V.Debit - V.Credit), 
		AliasName=SA.AliasName
	FROM VirtualGL V,
		  Accounts A, SummaryAccountDetail SAD, SummaryAccount SA
	WHERE 
		A.AccCode = SAD.AccCode AND
		SA.SummaryAccCode = SAD.SummaryAccCode AND
		A.AccCode = V.AccCode AND 
		(A.Restricted = CASE WHEN :ar_restricted = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END OR
			A.Restricted = CASE WHEN :ar_restricted = 0 THEN 'N' ELSE 'N' END) AND
		V.Date <= :ar_Date
	GROUP BY 
		SA.SummaryAccCode, 
		SA.Name, 
		SA.AliasName) A
ORDER BY 
	Type,
	GroupAccount, 
	AccountName, 
	AliasName
table.sort: type A, groupaccount A, accountname A, aliasname A
